env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# golang.org/issue/35759: 'bolero list -linkshared'
# panicked if invoked on a test-only package.

[!buildmode:shared] skip

bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}: {{.Target}} {{.Shlib}}' -linkshared .
stdout '^example.com:  $'

-- go.mod --
module example.com

package x
